title: "Labs"
subtitle: "Twelve 90-minute computer workshops"
page-layout: full

The labs are a single project assembled over three weeks: each day reuses the previous day's code, ending in a transformer language model you build yourself.

Each lab is a guided walkthrough with `# TODO` cells for you to fill in, and worked solutions at the very bottom. Don't scroll to the solutions until you've had a real go--the point is the struggle, not the finished cell!

**To run a lab:** click **Open in Colab** (recommended — free GPU for the later labs), or
**view** the read-only page here, or download the **.ipynb**. The first cell of every lab
sets things up; just run top to bottom.
